# Model Card — pdm_failure_predictor

**Status**: TRAINED — **XGBoost (chosen 2026-06-01; supersedes the earlier MLP)**. Stage 4 PREDICT step (KB_25).

## Overview
- **Name**: `pdm_failure_predictor` · **Active model**: **XGBoost** (`models/pdm_failure_predictor.xgb.json`).
- **Superseded**: MLP (`models/pdm_failure_predictor.pt`, kept for history) — PR-AUC 0.679.
- **Role**: per-snapshot machine **failure-risk** classifier. **Not** a certified safety function.
- **Inference**: `backend/ml/failure_predictor.py` (auto-selects XGBoost vs MLP from `model_meta.json["arch"]`;
  XGBoost uses **raw** features, MLP uses scaled). Honest: raises `ModelUnavailableError` if the brain/lib is absent.

## Why XGBoost (model selection)
Both trained on the same clean AI4I split. XGBoost won on the metric that matters for 3.4% imbalance:

| Model | ROC-AUC | **PR-AUC** | threshold (recall-tuned) |
|---|---|---|---|
| MLP | 0.972 | 0.679 | — |
| **XGBoost (chosen)** | 0.971 | **0.847** | 0.779 (val recall ≥ 0.80) |

Resolves gap **G-034**. The default at-risk threshold is the **recall-tuned** 0.779 (catch more failures — addresses **G-033**).

## Training data
AI4I 2020 (UCI, **CC BY 4.0**), 10,000 rows, ~3.4% failures. Features: Type(L/M/H), air/process temp,
rotational speed, torque, tool wear + engineered `temp_diff`, `power`. Leaky `TWF/HDF/PWF/OSF/RNF` **dropped**;
clean stratified 70/15/15 split (no leakage). Notebook: `notebooks/stage04b_xgboost_pdm_colab.ipynb`.

## Metrics (held-out test, n=1500; `models/pdm_failure_predictor.metrics.json`)
- **ROC-AUC 0.971** · **PR-AUC 0.847** (baseline = positive rate 0.034). Test positive rate 0.034 (no leakage).
- Thresholds: F1-optimal 0.745; **recall-tuned 0.779** (default, for maintenance).

## Limitations & risks (honest)
- **Proxy domain:** CNC-machine signals, **not robots / not our SimPy telemetry** — re-fit on real data before pilot (**G-035**).
- Per-snapshot risk only (no RUL / no causal root-cause — KB_25 steps 2–3).
- Free-cost (Colab free; no paid compute/API).
